jobs.title: Clinical Case Manager
jobs.description:
Under the supervision of the Case Management Program Manager, the **Case Manager \- Clinical will** be responsible for providing ongoing engagement, assessment, intervention, and evaluation for the youth on their individual case load. This includes youth intakes, assessments, crisis phone counseling, client data collection, documentation, file maintenance, and follow\-up care. In addition, the Case Manager will assist with general upkeep of the case management program, including regular program shift coverage, milieu management, crisis intervention, and ensuring that the program is facilitated in a manner that meets Urban Peak’s mission.

Case Managers will work with youth ages 12\-24 who are enrolled in Urban Peak’s programming who are experiencing homelessness. The acuity of clients varies, but this role will specialize in working with higher acuity clients to achieve goals including improved mental health and substance misuse issues. The acuity of clients varies, but this role will specialize in working with higher acuity clients to achieve goals including improved mental health and substance misuse issues, *and support with Family Mediation for Minor clients.* Weekly clinical case management sessions are conducted with each youth to review progress towards objectives and to provide support and accountability.

This position will ensure that interactions, interventions, and environments at Urban Peak are trauma\-informed and emphasize the physical and emotional safety of youth and staff.

**Who You Are:** 

* A master’s degree in social work, psychology, or child development AND a minimum of **four (4\)** **years’** treatment\-oriented or case management experience; OR a bachelor’s degree in behavioral science, human services, or related fields AND **five (5\) years’** experience working with children/youth; OR **six (6\+)** consecutive years’ full\-time (FT) experience with homeless or runaway youth.
* **Clinical license or license eligible** *(hours completed)* **(LPC, LMSW, LCSW, LMFT, LPCC) or Addiction Counselor Certification (CAC) preferred.**
* The ability to connect well, work effectively, and communicate in a culturally responsive manner with a diverse youth population.
* An understanding of trauma informed care and harm reduction principles and an ability to implement these approaches.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and to assess and change priorities based upon agency and client needs, in an environment that sometimes includes interpersonal conflict and chaos.
* Confidence in timely and accurate data collection and the ability to maintain accurate and thorough client files (this position will utilize Salesforce).
* Skilled in mediating and de\-escalating, particularly in sensitive situations. Able to make sound decisions, using available information while maintaining appropriate confidentiality.
* Able to function as a member of an interdisciplinary team and work with collaborating agencies.
* Ability to use second language in written and verbal communication desired (Spanish, Vietnamese, ASL) preferred but not required.
* Lived experience reflective of the youth we serve is encouraged but not required.
* Team\-oriented and able to coordinate with various departments and staff.
* Computer proficient and possess experience of Microsoft Office Suite (e.g. Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel).
* Must be insurable as a driver on Urban Peak’s auto liability policy to conduct business on behalf of the agency or transport youth using an Urban Peak vehicle and an approved personal vehicle.
* Ability to pass both federal and state background checks.
* Ability to pass pre\-employment TB Screening and a pre\-employment physical examination.
* Provide proof of education (HS Diploma OR Official Transcripts)

**What You Will Do:**

*The job duties of this position are performed personally, in cooperation with your supervisor, and/or in coordination with other staff. Additional work functions and duties may be assigned.*

***Case Management***

* Manages a case load of up to 30 clients. Meets with assigned youth on a weekly basis to create goals, review progress, and provide support and accountability.
* Will step in and assist with mediations with families for the minor specific program
* Provides personal interest and attention to each youth, supporting each young person in their unique social, emotional, and intellectual development.
* Assists clients in their movement through Urban Peak programs by helping them apply for Neighborhood and Housing programs in a timely manner.
* Provides guidance to youth that is based on the principles of trauma informed care, positive youth development, and harm reduction.
* Assists youth and other involved persons in facilitating safe and stable housing for the youth.
* Collaborate with other agencies for service delivery needs, staying current on resources and developments in this area of specialization.
* Cultivates a shame\-free case management relationship, where youth are able to communicate about their substance use, sexuality, gender, religion, mental health, neurodivergence, and other aspects of identity without fear of judgement or retaliation.
* Conducts and/or participates in circles of support or restorative conversations as needed.
* Acts as a positive role model by communicating consistently with youth and showing up on\-time for case management meetings.
* Attends all required staff meetings and weekly supervision prepared to provide client updates.
* Works with parents, legal guardians, or family members towards reunification, if appropriate.

***Milieu Supervision***

* During weekly program shift (4\-5 hrs.), holiday shifts, and on\-call shifts, the Case Manager focuses their attention on providing staff oversight of the shelter milieu area.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Location:** Remote (U.S.)  

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  

**Clearance:** Secret / Top Secret  

**Citizenship:** U.S. Citizen  

  

**About the Company**  

**We are a mission\-driven technology company specializing in Cloud, DevSecOps, Artificial Intelligence, and Digital Experience. We are a diverse team of innovators focused on creating open, scalable, and automated solutions that drive digital transformation in federal space. Our work culture fosters collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning.**  

  

**Job Summary**  

We are seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager to lead the execution of the Aerospace Readiness Enterprise System (ARES) Production program. This is a high\-visibility leadership role responsible for managing the successful delivery of a large\-scale Department of Defense (DoD) program while serving as the primary point of contact for government stakeholders.  

The Senior Program Manager will oversee program execution across multiple contract periods, ensuring the delivery of production\-ready capabilities that meet contractual, technical, schedule, and financial objectives. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing complex federal programs, leading cross\-functional Agile teams, and maintaining strong relationships with government customers and executive leadership.  

  

**Key Responsibilities*** Lead the execution and delivery of large\-scale, mission\-critical federal programs.
* Serve as the primary interface with the Government Agreements Officer (AO) and Agreements Officer Representative (AOR).
* Provide overall program leadership, ensuring successful execution of cost, schedule, scope, quality, and performance objectives.
* Facilitate Integrated Product Team (IPT) meetings, sprint reviews, program reviews, and retrospectives across multiple Agile teams.
* Manage the integrated program schedule, sprint velocity, and delivery forecasts to meet government milestones.
* Maintain and manage the program risk register, proactively identifying and mitigating program risks and issues.
* Escalate cross\-functional risks and dependencies to government stakeholders when appropriate.
* Ensure all contractual deliverables are completed accurately and submitted on time.
* Coordinate government\-directed User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities across multiple development sprints.
* Manage staffing, onboarding, resource planning, and personnel continuity throughout the contract lifecycle.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with government customers, executive leadership, subcontractors, and project teams.
* Monitor program financial performance, budgets, staffing, and contractual compliance.
* Develop and execute corrective action plans for schedule, cost, or performance variances.
* Mentor Program Managers, Project Managers, and Project Coordinators while promoting best practices in program delivery.
* Ensure compliance with applicable federal acquisition regulations, contract requirements, and organizational quality standards.

**Required Skills/Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum 8–12 years of experience managing large federal government programs or contracts.
* Demonstrated success managing complex programs valued at $10M or greater.
* Experience leading cross\-functional technical teams supporting software development, IT modernization, or defense programs.
* Strong understanding of Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS), and federal program governance.
* Excellent leadership, organizational, negotiation, and executive communication skills.
* Experience managing program budgets, schedules, risks, and contract performance.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent experience.
* Active U.S. Government Secret Clearance.

**Preferred Qualifications*** Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA), Management, Engineering, or related discipline.
* Experience supporting Department of Defense (DoD) acquisition programs.
* Familiarity with DoDI 5000\.87 or other DoD acquisition frameworks.
* Experience managing Agile software development programs.
* PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI\-ACP) certification or equivalent Agile experience.
* Active Top Secret Clearance.

**Benefits*** Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Plans (Healthcare benefits are 100% employer\-paid for employees only)
* Life Insurance
* Paid Time Off (Flexible/Combined PTO, Bereavement Leave, 11 Company Paid Holidays)
* 401K Retirement Plan with employer match
* Professional Development Training Reimbursement

jobs.title: Events & Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**THE AURORA CULTURE — BUILT TO WIN**

At Aurora Dermo, innovation is the foundation of every experience we create. We distribute advanced medical and aesthetic technologies designed to help practices improve clinical outcomes, expand their services, and grow sustainably.

Our events, workshops, courses, and webinars connect clients and industry professionals with the knowledge, technology, and commercial insights they need to succeed. We are looking for an organized, proactive coordinator who can turn plans into seamless, high\-quality experiences.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

As our Events \& Program Coordinator, you will lead the coordination, logistics, and execution of in\-person and online events, from initial planning through post\-event followup. Approximately 90% of the role is conducted through email, phone, and virtual collaboration with hotels, venues, vendors, clients, instructors, and our Marketing team.

This is a remote role with a preference for candidates based in Florida, who will have the added opportunity to support selected activities in person. The ideal candidate is resourceful, highly organized, comfortable negotiating with vendors, and able to manage multiple moving parts without losing sight of the attendee experience.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* **Coordinate Programs End to End:** plan and execute events, workshops, courses, webinars, and virtual sessions, managing timelines, deliverables, and follow\-up.
* **Manage Venues and Vendors:** research and contact hotels, meeting rooms, audiovisual providers, catering partners, and other suppliers; request proposals and negotiate rates and terms.
* **Own Event Logistics:** coordinate schedules, registrations, attendee communications, speaker requirements, materials, equipment, travel details, and on\-site needs.
* **Partner with Clients and Marketing:** align objectives, audiences, messaging, invitations, campaigns, and event assets with internal and external stakeholders.
* **Deliver Online Experiences:** set up and run webinars and virtual events, including invitations, registration links, technical checks, moderation support, recordings, and attendee follow\-up.
* **Control Budgets and Documentation:** track quotes, approvals, contracts, invoices, payment milestones, contact lists, attendance, and event expenses with accuracy.
* **Monitor Results:** prepare concise post\-event reports covering attendance, feedback, leads, costs, outcomes, and recommendations for future programs.
* **Support On\-Site Execution:** when based in Florida, attend selected activities to coordinate vendors, speakers, guests, setup, and real\-time issue resolution.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 3\+ years of experience coordinating corporate events, training programs, hospitality, conferences, webinars, or similar projects.
* Demonstrated ability to manage several events or workstreams simultaneously, with strong attention to deadlines and details.
* Strong vendor research, communication, and negotiation skills, including experience reviewing proposals and controlling costs.
* Professional fluency in English and Spanish, written and spoken, for communication with U.S. vendors, clients, and internal teams.
* Confident use of Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, spreadsheets, calendars, and virtual\-event platforms such as Zoom or Microsoft Teams.
* Experience with project\-management, CRM, registration, email\-marketing, or event\-management tools is preferred.
* Availability to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.
* **For Florida\-based candidates:** ability to travel to event locations and reliable transportation are preferred.

**WHAT MAKES YOU SUCCESSFUL HERE**

You are proactive, calm under pressure, and relentlessly organized. You communicate clearly, follow through without constant supervision, negotiate confidently, and anticipate problems before they reach the event floor. You care equally about operational precision and the experience of every client, speaker, and attendee.

**COMPENSATION \& WORK ARRANGEMENT**

* Full\-time position with a monthly base salary.
* Remote work arrangement; candidates based in Florida are preferred due to the opportunity to support selected events in person.
* Event\-related travel, venue access, and approved business expenses will be coordinated in advance in accordance with company policy.

**OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS — FAST AND TRANSPARENT**

* **Introductory Conversation:** a 30\-minute call with our Talent team to review your experience, communication skills, and alignment with the role.
* **Practical Interview:** a conversation with company leadership and Marketing focused on how you would plan an event, manage vendors, prioritize competing deadlines, and respond to an unexpected issue.
* **Offer \& Onboarding:** selected candidates receive a formal offer and a structured onboarding process covering Aurora’s portfolio, workflows, stakeholders, and upcoming event calendar.

**THE AURORA DIFFERENCE**

At Aurora, events are more than calendar dates, they are a strategic way to educate the market, strengthen client relationships, and bring advanced aesthetic technology to life. You will work directly with decision\-makers, help shape scalable event processes, and have visible impact as the company expands.

Pay: Up to $3,500\.00 per month

Work Location: Remote
